finding: persist_task_reassignment holds the task_state lock; _review_exception_capacity_evidence called load_runtime_state, which takes runtime_admission (lower rank). stable_sidecar_lock raised a lock order violation (runtime_admission -> task_state -> activity_audit) that the broad except turned into {}, so every considered family recorded 'no capacity evidence supplied' (seen 2026-11-20 12:27Z ENV-PROD-CONTROL-IMPL-001). Unit tests used a patched loader and never hit the real lock.
fix: Evidence reads runtime state via load_runtime_state_snapshot (lock-free, once per same-family reassignment). Failure now records evidence_unavailable:<ErrorClass> per family and logs the error to stderr; the string 'no capacity evidence supplied' is no longer written by the supervisor. No recurring job or persistent writer added; pair choice and incumbent rule unchanged.

tests.result: 430 tests; failures limited to 5 cwd-dependent worktree/.gitignore tests (OrphanUnmergedWorktreeStalenessTests x3, test_ignored_build_artifacts_do_not_dirty_worktree) plus the new test before its fixture fix; the new test was then fixed and passes
tests.note: the 4 unrelated tests use a relative .gitignore path and fail when run from .orchestrator; not touched by this change

tests.result: new real-lock test FAILS with evidence_unavailable:RuntimeError (reproduces the bug); passes with the fix

replay: test_real_lock_same_family_reassignment_records_concrete_reasons: real canonical_task_state_lock_file and real stable_sidecar_lock, no patched loader, incumbent same-family pair (Codex2/Codex) with healthy antigravity records available:antigravity.
